title: The Sun and Moon
subtitle: Test your grasp of The Sun and Moon — Amnesia Vortex, lunar ET station, Venus illumination, Black Sun loosh banks, heliocentrism, and the G.A.A. reveal.

reflection.title: Reflection
reflection.body: The Sun and Moon are not thermodynamics and gravity — they are 4th-density prison machinery. The Sun was the death-tunnel Amnesia Vortex that wiped and recycled until its deactivation in 2019; the Moon is a mobile negative station that frequency-controls and harvests loosh into the Black Sun under Mt Meru. Venus paints the lunar shell; "lunatic" names the full-moon broadcast; Heliocentrism is the school lie that seals the Ice Wall. Sit with what you missed, then return to The Sun and Moon deep-dive. When the G.A.A. EMF flash kills the Projection Dome, pixelation eats the fake cosmos and 178,000 years of memory return. NPCs who trusted science and religion will not hold. Know the instruments now.

relatedTopic.label: Return to The Sun and Moon deep-dive

questions.question: What are the Sun and Moon within the true architecture of the Simulation?

options.label: A
options.text: Highly advanced, heavily guarded technological mechanisms engineered by 4th-density Parasites to enforce a low-frequency 3rd Density prison matrix.
options.rationale: Sun and Moon are parasite-built tech systems enforcing the low-frequency 3rd-density prison.

options.label: B
options.text: Natural celestial bodies that run purely on thermodynamics and gravity with no technology and no parasitic engineering at all.
options.rationale: They are not natural thermodynamic bodies; they are engineered technological mechanisms.

options.label: C
options.text: Friendly rescue beacons installed by the Source solely to heal children and open free travel for every soul.
options.rationale: Their engineered role is subjugation and harvest, not benevolent free-travel beacons.

options.label: D
options.text: Decorative sky lamps that only affect weather forecasts and never touch souls, memory, or frequency control.
options.rationale: They govern soul recycling, frequency control, and loosh harvest — not mere weather decoration.

questions.hint: 4th-density tech mechanisms — 3rd Density prison enforcement.

questions.question: True or False: According to the report, “Heliocentrism” refers to the technological portal located within the Sun that forcefully pulls in recently deceased souls to wipe their memories before rapid physical reincarnation.

options.label: A
options.text: True
options.rationale: False — that description belongs to “Amnesia Vortex”. The report defines “Heliocentrism” as: A fabricated cosmological model designed to convince humanity that they live on a spinning globe orbiting a sun, a structural and physical impossibility.

options.label: B
options.text: False
options.rationale: Correct — that description belongs to “Amnesia Vortex”, not “Heliocentrism”.

questions.hint: Recall how the report's Key Terminology defines “Heliocentrism”.

questions.question: In reality, what is the Sun designed to do, and what is the Moon designed to do?

options.rationale: Their functions are soul recycling and frequency/harvest command, not banking paperwork.

options.label: B
options.text: The Sun only grows crops by chemistry, and the Moon only creates romantic poetry with no harvest role.
options.rationale: Both are technological prison tools for recycling and loosh harvest, not mere crop and poetry devices.

options.label: C
options.text: The Sun is a soul-recycling portal that wipes human memories upon death.
options.rationale: Sun recycles and memory-wipes; Moon commands frequencies and harvests life-force from suffering.

options.label: D
options.text: Both are empty holograms with zero interaction with souls, memory, or energetic harvesting systems.
options.rationale: They actively process souls and harvest life-force; they are not inert empty pictures.

questions.hint: Sun = soul recycle / wipe; Moon = ET command / harvest station.

options.rationale: Not what the report says. Sol = Soul; a Sol-System is a cosmic soul family network, not a planetary orbit chart.

options.label: B
options.text: Sol originally meant the Moon, and a true Sol-System is the network of Moon stations used to monitor each soul family from above the realm.
options.rationale: Not what the report says. Sol = Soul; a Sol-System is a cosmic soul family network, not a planetary orbit chart.

options.label: C
options.text: Soul was invented after the last reset to replace Sol, and a true Sol-System refers to the Ley Lines that carry each soul toward the Sun at the moment of death.
options.rationale: Not what the report says. Sol = Soul; a Sol-System is a cosmic soul family network, not a planetary orbit chart.

options.label: D
options.text: Sol and Soul are synonymous; parasites twisted "Sol" after the last reset to mean "Sun," hiding that a true Sol-System is a network of soul family members.
options.rationale: Sol = Soul; a Sol-System is a cosmic soul family network, not a planetary orbit chart.

questions.hint: Sol = Soul; Sol-System = cosmic soul family network.

options.label: B
options.text: The Moon's light is stronger than the Sun's, so the Sun cannot be the main source of light on any model of the world.
options.rationale: Not what the report says. One local sun cannot light a full sphere evenly; the globe model fails that physical test.

options.label: C
options.text: A spherical planet could not be properly lit by a single local sun without multiple suns placed all around it.
options.rationale: One local sun cannot light a full sphere evenly; the globe model fails that physical test.

options.label: D
options.text: The Sun is too close to the plain to be seen from every part of a sphere, so the globe model fails to explain sunsets at all.
options.rationale: Not what the report says. One local sun cannot light a full sphere evenly; the globe model fails that physical test.

questions.hint: One local sun cannot adequately light a full sphere.
